unify.title: Indlela yokuhlanganisa ukusabalalisa kube yindlela eyodwa
unify.summary: Khuyini okufuze ihlanganiswe kokuthoma lokha nakuthengiswa, indawo yokugcina izinto kanye namaqoqo ahlala emafayeleni ahlukileko.
points: Thoma ngamakhasimende, imikhiqizo kanye namanani: ngibo ababalisi woke umuntu asebenzisako.
Xhumanisa i-oda nesitoko ngaphambi kokufaka ezinye iinsetjenziswa.
Ilinganisa inani elilula: ama-oda agcwaliswe ngaphandle kokwenza kabutjha ifomu.

offline.title: Abasebenzi abathengisako basebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi
offline.summary: Khuyini ekufanele ifunwe kuhlelo lokusebenza loku-oda ukwenzela bona umthengisi angajumi ngebanga lesignali.
points: Ikhathalogu nesikhwama semali kufanele kube sefonini, ingasi efwini kwaphela.
I-oda ligcinwa kudivayisi bese lilayitjhwa lokha inethiwekhi nayibuyako.
Lokha nakuvumelanisa, i-oda sele lingena endaweni yokugcina izinto.

warehouse.title: Indawo yokubeka izinto enebhakhodi, ngaphandle kwephepha
warehouse.summary: Indlela yokusuka erhelweni eligadangisiweko ukuya ekukhetheni okuqinisekisiweko efonini.
points: Yamukela ngokujamelana ne-oda lokuthenga, ingasi ngokujamelana nememori.
Qinisekisa into ngayinye lokha nawuhlukanisako. Isibungu sisika ngephaseji.

finance.title: Iqoqo elihambisana nokuthengiswa
finance.summary: Kubayini umthengisi kufuze abone isikwelede somthengi ngaphambi kokuthatha enye i-oda.
points: Ukuvakatjha sikhathi esihle sokubuthelela, nangabe isikwelede sibonakala.
Ukuthengisa nezezimali kufanele ziqale ikhasimende elifanako.
Umbiko wangamalanga ongaphelelwa sikhathi uqakatheke ukudlula ukuvala ngemva kwesikhathi.

legal.privacy_intro: Umthethomgomo lo uchaza bona senzani ngedatha oyitjhiya emafomini kule sayithi.

privacy.title: Ngiyiphi idatha esiyibuthelelako
privacy.text: Nawubawa ukutjengisa namkha usitlolela, sibulunga ibizo, ikhamphani, i-imeyili, inomboro yomtato nangabe uyitjengisa, inarha, ubukhulu besiqhema, umkhiqizo owuthandako nomlayezo. Siphinde sirekhode ilanga, ilimi lekhasi kanye nekheli le-IP, ukukhandela ukuthunyelwa okuhlukumezako.

privacy.title: Sizisebenziselani?
privacy.text: Sisebenzisa idatha le ukuphendula kwaphela, ukuhlanganisa idemo nokulungiselela isiphakamiso sezokuthengisa. Asizithengiseli namkha sizinike irhelo labanye abantu.

privacy.title: Zigcinwa kuphi begodu isikhathi esingangani?
privacy.text: Iimbawo zigcinwa kuseva yesayithi le. Sizigcina isikhathi esitlhogekako ukukusebenzela nokulandelela kwezokuthengisa, begodu siyazisusa lokha nawusibawako nofana lokha nazingasatlhogeki.

privacy.title: Amalungelo wakho
privacy.text: Ungabawa ukufikelela, ukulungiswa nofana ukususwa kwedatha yakho efomini lokuthintana, uyitjengise emlayezweni. Nangabe ikhamphani igadangisa i-imeyili kuwebhusayithi le, nawe ungatlola lapho.

legal.terms_intro: Imibandela le isebenza ekusetjenzisweni kwesayithi lokuthunyelwa kwe-FullVendor.

terms.title: Ilwazi lezokuthengisa
terms.text: Imitlolo, isibonelo semifanekiso yedeshibhodi kanye neenhlathululo zethula iplatifomu. Zingalungiswa lokha umkhiqizo nawutjhugulukako begodu akusiwo umnikelo ovaliweko.

terms.title: Idemo akusiso isivumelwano
terms.text: Ukuthumela iforomo akutjho bona kube nesibopho sokuthenga nofana ukubeka intengo. Nanyana ngisiphi isivumelwano sivunyelwa ngokwehlukana, ngokutlola, ngobubanzi nemibandela yaso.

terms.title: Okuqukethwe yisayithi
terms.text: Iphawu lokurhweba le-FullVendor, amagama wemikhiqizo kanye nokuqukethwe kwamakhasi la kungokwabanikazi bawo. Angeze zakopishwa ukuveza omunye umkhiqizo.

terms.title: Ukusetjenziswa okwamukelekako
terms.text: Ungasebenzisi amafomu ukuthumela ilwazi elingasiqiniso, i-spam nofana okuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni. Singaziba iimbawo ezingakhambisani nekulumiswano yamabhizinisi.
